content.title: Arkansas Razorbacks win NCAA tournament opener
content.text: The Arkansas Razorbacks defeated the Hawai'i Rainbow Warriors 97-78 in their NCAA tournament first-round matchup. Hawai'i secured its 13-seed by winning the Big West Tournament Championship and finishing second overall in conference play.Arkansas had only played Hawai'i twice before Thursday, winning both games on back-to-back days in December 1977 in Honolulu. When & where to watch Arkansas basketball Arkansas' next game will be on Saturday against No. 12 High Point. The High Point Panthers upset No. 5 Wisconsin on Thursday. The Sweet Sixteen and Elite Eight are scheduled for Mar. 26 through Mar. 29. If Arkansas makes it to these rounds, it would play at the SAP Center in San Jose, California. The Final Four will be played on Apr. 4 and 6 in Indianapolis. SEC ChampionshipThe Razorbacks won the SEC Tournament on Sunday afternoon. It's their first since 2000.Arkansas defeated Vanderbilt (75-86) in Nashville, Tennessee.Head coach John Calipari is now the first coach to win the SEC Tournament with multiple programs.Earlier this month, Calipari became only the fifth coach in NCAA Division I history to win 900 games.
